summary: Video editor and motion designer who builds the tools. Ten years as lead editor on national campaigns for Google, Under Armour, Kate Spade and Nuuly — and the author of VCR, a headless motion renderer in Rust that turns YAML scenes into ProRes 4444 with alpha. I work at the seam between the edit and the toolchain, which is why the output arrives fast and repeats. Looking for a full-time role on a team that ships.

built.name: VCR
built.line: Motion graphics from the terminal: YAML scenes in, ProRes 4444 with alpha out.
built.body: A headless renderer for repeatable motion work — write a scene once, change the data, render the variants. No GUI, no timeline to babysit. Declarative scenes, custom shaders, text and layered compositing, GPU-accelerated on Apple Silicon.

built.name: ColorWizard
built.line: From a reference color to a paint mix and a thread match.
built.body: An instrument for artists who work in physical materials: sample a color from any image and get a practical oil-paint recipe plus the closest DMC thread. Live as a web app and a desktop build.

built.name: MagpieApp
built.line: A photograph into a thread-matched hand-embroidery pattern.
built.body: Runs entirely offline. Built for and used by a working embroidery studio, where the pattern it outputs is the pattern that gets stitched.

built.name: coltonbatts.com
built.line: A self-built publishing system with a WebGL2 darkroom render layer.
built.body: Astro site with a custom GPU pass for film grain, halation and develop, plus an automated image pipeline that carries 24 archive photographs and the commercial portfolio.
